comments: We were the first to enter the apartment, it was very clean, stunningly decorated and in general there is a feeling of home from the moment you enter. Anything we needed we turned to David and he was available for all requests and always gave a quick and immediate response. The bed and sofa are very comfortable. The heating in the house is excellent and in general we really enjoyed the service. Regarding the location of the apartment, it is not in the center of Vienna, but a distance away by train, the location suited us because we were with a baby and a toddler and we were looking for a quiet place to stay and with many public gardens around. There are 3 supermarkets within walking distance and also a shopping center within walking distance. We were a total of 3 weeks and enjoyed every moment, highly recommend :)
